_about: The points you can click on the map (Vegetation page). Each needs an id from data/points.json. Other points are shown as small dots only. After changing this list, run analysis/satellite/export_points.py again (it writes the NDVI lines, trend and breakpoints only for these points). "description" (optional): a short paragraph of plain text about the point (no HTML), shown in the card under the map when the point is selected; leave it empty ("") until it is written.
